headline: Ukrainian Strikes Halt Rail Traffic Across Crimea's Kerch Bridge
summary: A third missile attack in four days halted railway transport on the Kerch Bridge connecting Russia to Crimea after Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck infrastructure sections.
why: The Kerch Bridge is Russia's primary logistical artery for military and industrial supply lines into the Crimean peninsula.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Disruption to the Kerch Bridge rail line severed direct logistical transit into Crimea.
